purpose: Cold-start safety and memory screen for two isolated Unreal OpenGL UBO hypotheses before any authenticated late-PvP A/B.

fixed_stack.guest_renderer: Unreal OpenGL ES -> guest ANGLE -> Vulkan ranchu

interpretation.startup: Both candidates cold-booted to a live TFT process and were applied by DeviceProfile priority.
interpretation.memory: The 16-MiB setting did not preallocate 16 MiB at this login-screen sample; its RSS was 1244 KiB and PSS 817 KiB above the direct-write run, which is within uncontrolled cold-start variation and is not a matched control result.
interpretation.stability: Both samples had an empty Android crash buffer and the same pre-existing tombstone count.
interpretation.boundary: No FPS, frame pacing, render correctness, in-combat allocation behavior, or late-PvP benefit is established. Both remain unpromoted.
